title: Thai Cement Manufacturers Association advances ASEAN decarbonisation
summary: Thai Cement Manufacturers Association advances ASEAN decarbonisation
body_markdown:
**Thailand:** The Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) has helped reduce the ASEAN cement industry’s CO₂ emissions by 14.4Mt in 2025, down by 6% year-on-year against 2020 levels, under the 2035 ASEAN Federation of Cement Manufacturers (AFCM) Decarbonisation Roadmap. The reductions were attributed to increased adoption of reduced-CO₂ cement, alternative fuels and renewable electricity.


The eight AFCM member countries aim to reduce cumulative CO₂ emissions by 35.2Mt between 2020 and 2030 and by 42.9Mt between 2020 and 2035. The Philippines and Indonesia have developed national cement decarbonisation roadmaps, while Thailand is advancing its 2050 Net Zero Cement and Concrete Roadmap.
